scripts.//test:integration: Split in two, run against DIFFERENT emulator sets (see scripts/test-emulator.sh). RULES tests use clearFirestore, which fires triggers — running them with NO functions emulator means onCardDeleted never fires on the mass-deletes and cannot race a reused card id. FN tests genuinely exercise triggers/callables and need functions. New rules-style tests: add to :rules. New trigger/callable tests: add to :fn (they will fail fast in :rules without a functions runtime). Bounded --retry absorbs transient emulator hiccups; a real failure still fails all attempts. Unit tests stay strict.
scripts.test:integration:rules: vitest run test/integration/cardRules.test.ts test/integration/boardRules.test.ts test/integration/commentRules.test.ts test/integration/attachmentRules.test.ts test/integration/labelRules.test.ts test/integration/statsRules.test.ts test/integration/rules.test.ts test/integration/concurrentMoves.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --retry=2
scripts.test:integration:fn: vitest run test/integration/authTrigger.test.ts test/integration/accountExists.test.ts test/integration/signUpGate.test.ts test/integration/setUserAccess.test.ts test/integration/cardTriggers.test.ts test/integration/attachments.test.ts test/integration/labels.test.ts test/integration/boardCardCount.test.ts test/integration/notifications.test.ts test/integration/notificationSweep.test.ts test/integration/stats.test.ts test/integration/lastActivity.test.ts test/integration/boardOwnership.test.ts test/integration/health.test.ts test/integration/acceptRules.test.ts test/integration/reports.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --retry=2
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
